name: qualien-mcp
description: One MCP server that gives your AI assistant a QA toolkit: Playwright, your test files, GitHub, Jira, Postgres and more.
long_description: qualien-mcp is a composite MCP gateway for SDET / QE work. Out of the box it serves Playwright MCP (browser automation, accessibility snapshots, screenshots) and Filesystem MCP scoped to the project folder you pick. Put a qualien-mcp.config.json in that folder to turn on more of its 21 catalog servers (GitHub, Postgres, MySQL, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Selenium, WebdriverIO, BrowserStack, Chrome DevTools, Sentry and others), with per-tool allow/deny and read-only-by-default database guardrails. Requires Node.js 20+ with npx on your PATH; the catalog servers are started with npx.

project_dir.title: Project folder
project_dir.description: The folder the Filesystem tools can read and edit (your tests, page objects, fixtures). A qualien-mcp.config.json in this folder turns on more servers.
